notes: Ten levels read from the teleport graph (gb-maps-1, 2026-10-09): tpN.M is level N's checkpoint M, every level's last door (a 7x168x264 gate) aims at the next level's tpN.1, and level 10's last door (-2604 4000 -13820) aims at `fin`, a hub whose own doors lead to every level's start -- the map's level select. The two bonuses also end at fin, so the finish is level 10's door itself, not every teleport into the hub. The lobby (24 spawns, long-jump pads lj1..3) has the door into level 1 at (1180 236 -60). Bonuses (bonus1, bonus2) are not timed tracks yet. 105 MB; not published.
